verifications.note: Plant 1073, generator 4, status OP, nameplate 148.8 MW, natural gas steam turbine, operating year 1967

Status.note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists unit 4 as operating on natural gas. Alliant Energy's annual report for 2025 lists Prairie Creek unit 4 among Interstate Power and Light's gas plants. It says units 3 and 4 face a federal rule, but no retirement of unit 4 is announced.

Start year.note: GEM's 2017 is the year the unit began burning gas. A Gazette article from November 2017 says crews were converting Prairie Creek unit 4 from coal to natural gas, with the work to finish that week. An Associated Press story from November 2, 2017 says the same. So this is a conversion and the unit began burning gas in 2017. The EIA table shows 1967 because that is when the original coal unit started. Under GEM's conversion rule 2017 is correct, so no change is needed.
